LESSON: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MIRACLES OF JESUS CHRIST
Topic 3.1: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
2. Practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus in the examples.
2. Explain Healing of Blind Bartimaeus to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Healing of Blind Bartimaeus important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
2. Practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
